thread:
emma (support): URGENT: Customer acme-inc reports intermittent KMS keystore failures causing decryption API 503s and downstream order processing to fail. Started after keystore rolling update last night. Customer is blocking. Request id: req_x4b9f2a

deploy-bot: deploy redwood-keystore v2.14 rolled in us-west-2 at 2025-10-09T03:12:10Z

carlos (CS): Ack. Is this affecting only acme-inc or multiple tenants? severity P0? :exclamation:

emma (support): Only acme-inc so far (prod). They report ~15% of decrypt calls returning 503/timeout, spikes every ~5-10m. Their SLA is impacted, asking for ETA <4h.

jin (eng-sre): Looking. Can you paste a repro curl + the full error from logs (request id)? We'll triage.

emma (support): Repro snippet from customer:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/keys/decrypt
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-acme-123'
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json'
  -d '{"key_id":"key_abc","ciphertext":"BASE64..."}'
```
Response: 503 Service Unavailable
Error (server): ``keystore-error: hsm-proxy timeout after 2000ms``
Trace: trace_id=tr_9f2a, req=req_x4b9f2a

noah (platform): HSM cluster reported some transient timeouts during last night's rolling update. We have a fallback flag `KEYSTORE_SOFTWARE_FALLBACK` but it's gated behind sec approval.

olivia (sec): Important: fallback to software keystore must NOT export cleartext key material outside HSM boundary. We need audit evidence that keywraps remain unchanged. Also need to record an incident ticket for compliance if we enable fallback.

jin (eng-sre): I can reproduce locally against staging hsm-proxy with reduced timeouts. Logs show repeated: `hsm-proxy: connect error: dial tcp 10.4.3.21:1500: i/o timeout` followed by `keystore-init: HSM unresponsive: timeout`. Looks like the rolling update briefly left a subset of HSM proxies with aggressive conn limits.

emma (support): Customer asking for mitigation now — they want a temporary workaround while you patch. They said manual decrypt of a few critical orders would be acceptable if we can do it securely.

noah (platform): Two mitigation options: 1) enable software fallback (fast, temporary) 2) revert to previous keystore release (riskier rollback). Both need sec + PM signoff. I can run a canary for fallback in us-west-2.

olivia (sec): If we do fallback, we must: a) enable it only for acme-inc tenant ID, b) ensure no key export logs, c) capture audit logs of all decrypt operations during fallback. Also notify legal/compliance. Otherwise prefer controlled rollback.

jin (eng-sre): Proposed hotfix: increase hsm-proxy connection timeout from 2000ms -> 10000ms and add 3x retry with exponential backoff + jitter. Do canary on 2 nodes, monitor error rate and latency. Estimated time: 30–60 minutes to validate and roll. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

deploy-bot: hotfix pipeline triggered: build #789 -> canary us-west-2 (2 nodes) -> waiting on manual approval

carlos (CS): I'll tell acme-inc we're in active triage, rolling a hotfix canary in ~10m and ETA ~45m-1h. Offer manual decrypts for highest-priority orders; prepare to coordinate with ops for secure handling.

emma (support): Customer accepted canary. They're sending 3 request IDs that failed previously for us to validate once patch is live: req_x4b9f2a, req_x4b9f3c, req_x4b9f7e

jin (eng-sre): Copy. I'll push hotfix and post back test results. Quick note: patch does not touch key material or keywrap flow. Only changes timeout + retry behavior in hsm-proxy client.

olivia (sec): Good. Please attach the canary audit logs to the incident and tag compliance. Also open an internal follow-up to review rolling update rollout policy and HSM health gating.

emma (support): Thanks team. I'll update acme-inc with the timeline and request they hold off manual work until we confirm canary. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: canary started at 2025-10-09T04:05:12Z on nodes keystore-uw2-a,b. Monitoring metrics: hsm_errors -> 12 -> 2 (pre/post canary).

jin (eng-sre): Canary looks good for the two nodes (errors down). Proceeding to full roll with 10m pause per AZ. Rolling now.

emma (support): Customer confirmed orders processing resumed after ~20m, they reported no new 503s in the last 15m. They asked for postmortem and assurance that this won't recur.

olivia (sec): I'll own the compliance/PM notification for the postmortem. Please include: timeline, root cause (rolling update left hsm-proxy with low conn/timeouts), mitigation, and permanent fix plan (better gating + telemetry).

carlos (CS): I'll follow up with acme-inc on SLA credits and make sure they have a POC for manual decrypts if needed.

emma (support): Closing loop here — will file incident ticket and add required CIAs. Thanks everyone. :lock:
